title: Messaging SMS Send Command
description: Imperative request to send an sms text from one of the operator's Telnyx numbers. The executor answers with messaging.sms.sent (accepted) and then messaging.sms.completed or messaging.sms.failed, carrying this command_id. Telnyx long codes need 10DLC registration to reach US mobiles (error 40010 otherwise). Recommended idempotency_key: 'messaging.sms.send:<to>:<sha256(text)>:<minute>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (messaging).

from.description: Sending Telnyx number (E.164); null uses the default line.
